messages:
Alice Nguyen: Hey team — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/8423. Adds a quantization profile for `llm2-small` and a tiny tokenizer whitespace tweak. Local unit+integration tests passed. Can someone take a quick look? Hoping to land before EOD if no blockers.

Ben Patel: On it, taking a look now.

Cara Morales: quick q — will the new quant profile affect Dedicated customers by default or is it behind a flag?

Alice Nguyen: It's behind the `quant_variant: llm2-small-q4` model variant flag — won't replace existing profiles. Added a note in the PR description and in model-profiles/README.

dev-bot: CI started for PR #8423 — jobs: lint, unit, integration, perf-smoke.

Ben Patel: Found a small nit in `tokenizer/whitespace.py` — suggest changing this:```python
- if text.endswith(' '):
-     return tokens + ['▁']
+ if text.endswith(' '):
+     return tokens + ['▁']  # preserve trailing space as explicit token
```
Just a comment inline, behavior same but helps future readers.

Dave Li: adding to that — can you also add a one-line changelog under `models/CHANGELOG.md`? helps release notes.

Alice Nguyen: good catches, will push a small commit with the comment and changelog.

Erin O'Neill: FYI I'll run a quick Dedicated perf smoke after merge. If perf-smoke CI fails we should hold.

Ben Patel: CI job `integration/test-kvcache` failed on first run (flaky). Rerunning now.

dev-bot: Rerun triggered by @Ben Patel — waiting for results.

dev-bot: CI passed for PR #8423 (all checks green).

Alice Nguyen: pushed fixes and changelog, PTAL.

Ben Patel: LGTM :thumbsup: — approving.

Cara Morales: Approving as well. Added one tiny suggestion in the PR UI (non-blocking).

Dave Li: Approved, good to merge after Erin's perf smoke if we want extra caution.

Erin O'Neill: Running perf checks now on a small staging cluster. Should have results in ~20m.

(20m later) Erin O'Neill: Perf smoke looks fine — latency and token throughput within baseline +/- 2%. No regressions observed.

Alice Nguyen: Thanks everyone. Merging now.

dev-bot: PR #8423 merged by @Alice Nguyen into `main`. Change summary: add `llm2-small` quant profile, tokenizer whitespace comment, changelog entry.

Ben Patel: Nice, thanks for handling the nits quickly.

Cara Morales: :rocket:

Alice Nguyen: Appreciate the quick reviews!
